description: The products a CVE affects, one page at a time, with the vulnerable products first. The vendor and product arguments keep only the products with that exact name. For the CVEs of one product, call cve_search.

offset.description: Products to skip; pass next_offset of the previous page

product.description: Exact product name, as affected_products writes it

vendor.description: Exact vendor name, as affected_products writes it

name: cve_products

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

limit.description: Most items in results: the limit argument, 20 by default.

next_offset.description: offset plus this page's items; total on the last page.

offset.description: Items skipped: the offset argument, 0 by default.

results.description: Vulnerable products first, then by vendor and product.

cpe_part.description: a, o or h from the CPE name: application, operating system or hardware. Absent on a cna element.

default_status.description: affected, unaffected or unknown from the CNA; null if none. Absent on an nvd element.

product.description: null when the CPE name leaves the product open.

vendor.description: null when the CPE name leaves the vendor open.

version_start_including.description: Absent when the range has no such bound. The same holds for each other version_* member.

versions.description: The CNA's version entries as written; null if none. Only on a cna element.

total.description: Products that match the filters, before paging.

title: CVE Affected Products
